weather_line: Fog thickening in the gorge · the hollows are thinking about it

stories.headline: Briefcase Opens Briefly at 11:43 a.m.; Closes Before Anyone Can Agree on What They Saw; the Clerk's Report Has Been Confiscated; the Clerk Is Fine
stories.byline: By our Unattributed Correspondent (do not ask)
body: At precisely 11:43 a.m. on Friday, in the Ministry of Magic's Level Six Lost Property Repository, the briefcase opened. This is not in dispute. What was inside the briefcase is, entirely, in dispute, and will remain so pending review of the review of the preliminary review currently being reviewed by a sub-committee that cannot confirm its own existence.

The discovering clerk — one T. Wrobel, reassigned on Thursday and reassigned again on Friday to a desk with no chair — filed a report. The report was confiscated within four minutes. Wrobel has since filed a report about the confiscation. That report has also been confiscated. Wrobel appears, by all accounts, to be enjoying himself.

What the three witnessing parties agree on: it was bright. What they do not agree on: whether bright means golden, amber, or — per the sole Department of Mysteries representative, who has since declined to speak further — 'a colour I have not seen before and would not like to name.' The hum, sources confirm, resolved briefly into something that sounded almost like a chord. Then the briefcase closed, and the hum resumed its previous pitch, and the morning continued.

stories.headline: The Jeep's Eleven Ducks Convene a Saturday Morning Assembly; Agenda Unclear; Quorum Achieved; the Deerstalker Duck Presides
stories.byline: Adventure Desk, filed from the driveway
body: With the gorge fog advancing into the lower hollows and Saturday presenting no pressing obligation, the enchanted Jeep sat in the drive and its eleven hatted familiars held what observers have described as 'a convening.' The deerstalker duck — long accepted as the detective — occupied the forward position and appeared to chair proceedings.

Steve, who emerged at half seven with coffee and no agenda, regarded the assembly for a moment, nodded as though this were reasonable, and went inside. The Jeep forgave him for it immediately, as it does.

stories.headline: Saturday Arrives Without Requirements; Christine Receives It Graciously; the Household Follows Her Lead; Jersey Already Ahead of Them All
body: In a rare diplomatic achievement requiring no negotiation whatsoever, Saturday morning came in quietly, made no demands, and was accepted without conditions. Christine, noted throughout Gringotts for settling disputes before the opposing party finishes its sentence, accepted the morning's terms in under thirty seconds and was horizontal again shortly thereafter.
Jersey, for his part, had already identified the warmest available lap before anyone else had located a kettle. He has been there since. No formal comment has been issued. None is required.

stories.headline: Lucy Receives Interim Credit for the Unattributed Ministry Memo; Lucy Neither Confirms Nor Denies; Lucy's Expression Constitutes a Tertiary Source
body: Following Friday's reporting that an unattributed internal Ministry memo — the one reading 'Has anyone simply tried opening it?' — has been circulating through three departments and one department that does not exist, investigators at this paper have returned once more to the most plausible candidate.

Lucy was found in the kitchen at time of enquiry, sitting with the compact stillness of a creature who has never once done anything requiring explanation. She declined to comment. Her ears, however, were briefly and unmistakably satisfied.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Was in the kitchen all morning. Has receipts for being in the kitchen all morning. Would like the kitchen receipts entered into the formal record. The biscuit tin has, separately, not moved.

Ellie: Discovered the fog through the window and stood watching it for some time with an expression of polite wonder, then turned to see if anyone else had noticed the fog, then turned back in case the fog had noticed her. It had not. She remains open to the possibility.
Jersey: Has not left the lap. Has been asked no questions. Has answered none. Is warm, is comfortable, and has excelled at Saturday in a way that others may study but cannot replicate.
founding_editor_note: A Saturday with no agenda is a Saturday you built properly the first time. I always left those load-bearing. — D.

in_brief.sport: The Holyhead Harpies report a comfortable win; the commentary notes that Christine, watching from Gringotts, did not require the score to know the outcome.
in_brief.forecast: Fog holds through noon in the gorge; clears on the ridge by early afternoon; the hollows will decide for themselves.

storyline_updates.title: The Briefcase
storyline_updates.summary: Day 3: The briefcase opened briefly at 11:43 a.m. Three witnesses disagree on what they saw; one described a colour without a name. The clerk's report has been confiscated; the clerk is cheerful. The hum briefly resolved to a chord before returning. Day 4 should move toward identification — perhaps Wrobel's confiscated reports are partially leaked, or a fourth party surfaces with a competing and unexpectedly specific claim of ownership, or someone outside the Ministry who has no reason to know about the briefcase asks after it by name.
